from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,gzip,hashlib,datetime
D=['/usr/local/bin/docker','--context','colima-sail-gate']
assert not subprocess.check_output(D+['ps','-q'],text=True).strip()
root=Path('/Users/alexy/src/sail-extensions-gates/stream-experiments-20260930/disk-cleanup-20261001/build-containers02');root.mkdir()
records=[]
for selected in ITEMS:
 raw=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(D+['inspect',selected['id']],text=True))[0]
 assert raw['Name']=='/'+selected['name'] and raw['Id']==selected['id'] and raw['State']['Status']=='exited' and raw['State']['ExitCode']==0 and not raw['State']['Running']
 diff=subprocess.check_output(D+['diff',selected['id']],text=True)
 assert hashlib.sha256(('\n'.join(sorted(diff.splitlines()))+'\n').encode()).hexdigest()==selected['diff_sha256']
 metadata={k:raw[k] for k in ['Id','Name','State','Image','Mounts']};metadata['command']=raw['Config']['Cmd'];metadata['entrypoint']=raw['Config']['Entrypoint'];metadata['diff_sha256']=selected['diff_sha256']
 p=root/selected['name'];p.mkdir()
 (p/'metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2)+'\n');(p/'filesystem-diff.txt').write_text(diff)
 logs=subprocess.run(D+['logs','--timestamps',selected['id']],capture_output=True,timeout=120);assert logs.returncode==0,logs.stderr
 for name,data in [('stdout.gz',logs.stdout),('stderr.gz',logs.stderr)]:
  with gzip.open(p/name,'wb') as f:f.write(data)
 hashes={f.name:hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in p.iterdir() if f.is_file()}
 result=subprocess.run(D+['rm',selected['id']],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
 record={'recorded_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'name':selected['name'],'id':selected['id'],'evidence':str(p),'evidence_sha256':hashes,'remove':{'returncode':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr},'volumes_removed':False}
 (p/'removal.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');records.append(record)
 assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr
 assert subprocess.run(D+['inspect',selected['id']],capture_output=True).returncode!=0
print(json.dumps({'outcome':'passed','records':records,'running_after':subprocess.check_output(D+['ps','-q'],text=True)}))
